rework_notes: Review rejected the previous attempt. it does not conform to the Contract: _Request.committed infers whether an edit or move committed solely from final field equality, which cannot establish the Contract's required commit outcome: a rejected same-value edit can suppress the required warning, while a committed edit overwritten by another participant before closure can trigger a false 'not saved' warning. The new tests cover only mutations whose requested values differ from persisted state, leaving these cases untested.
